bank.title: MAT 206 - Introduction to Geometry and Probability - CheckIt Bank

outcome.title: Symmetry in 2D Figures
outcome.description: I can, given a 2D figure, identify any lines of symmetry and point symmetry, as well as calculate angles of rotational symmetry.

outcome.title: Categorizing Polygons
outcome.description: I can identify members of one set of polygons as sometimes, always, or never belonging to another set of polygons.

outcome.title: Explaining Polygon Relationships
outcome.description: I can explain why members of one set of polygons sometimes, always, or never belong to another set of polygons.

outcome.title: Identifying Angles
outcome.description: I can identify pairs of angles as alternate interior, alternate exterior, corresponding, vertical, supplementary, and/or complementary.

outcome.title: Explaining with Special Angles
outcome.description: I can use the properties of 2D figures to find missing angles, and use angle measures to draw conclusions about 2D figures.

outcome.title: Properties of 3D Space
outcome.description: I can identify and apply properties of lines, planes, and polyhedra in 3D space.

outcome.title: Justifying Spatial Relationships
outcome.description: I can use geometric properties and definitions to justify spatial relationships between lines, planes, and solids.

outcome.title: Nets of 3D Figures
outcome.description: I can draw accurate nets of 3D figures.

outcome.title: Pythagorean Theorem and Similar Triangles
outcome.description: I can solve problems involving triangles by using the Pythagorean theorem and/or properties of similar triangles.

outcome.title: Geometric Transformations
outcome.description: I can identify and perform transformations such as rotations, dilations, reflections, or translations.

outcome.title: Measuring Angles and Lengths
outcome.description: I can measure angles and lengths with a protractor and ruler, and identify angles as acute, obtuse, right, or straight.

outcome.title: Unit Conversions
outcome.description: I can convert from one unit to another, and apply these conversions to solve problems.

outcome.title: Perimeter and Circumference
outcome.description: I can compute perimeters and circumferences of 2D figures.

outcome.title: Areas of 2D Shapes
outcome.description: I can compute the areas of polygons, circles, sectors, and composite shapes.

outcome.title: Explaining Area Formulas
outcome.description: I can explain the meaning of area and explain why the area formulas for parallelograms, triangles, kites, and trapezoids work.

outcome.title: Surface Areas of 3D Figures
outcome.description: I can compute the surface area of prisms, pyramids, spheres, cylinders, cones and composite figures.

outcome.title: Volumes of 3D Figures
outcome.description: I can compute the volume of prisms, pyramids, spheres, cylinders, cones, and composite figures.

outcome.title: Explaining Volume and Surface Area Formulas
outcome.description: I can explain the meaning of volume and explain why the volume and/or surface area formulas for prisms, pyramids, and cylinders work.

outcome.title: Arithmetic and Geometric Sequences
outcome.description: I can identify sequences as arithmetic or geometric, and construct functions which output their nth term.

outcome.title: Writing Algebraic Expressions and Equations
outcome.description: I can write algebraic expressions and equations based on written descriptions.

outcome.title: Explaining Properties of Equality
outcome.description: I can explain the properties of equality, the common misconceptions about equality, and how to address those misconceptions.

outcome.title: Identifying Functions
outcome.description: I can identify relations as functions.

outcome.title: Explaining Functions
outcome.description: I can explain why a relation is or is not a function based on the definition of a function.

outcome.title: Linear Equations and Graphing
outcome.description: I can use graphical information to determine the equation of a line, and graph a line given its equation.

outcome.title: Explaining Slope and Linearity
outcome.description: I can explain the concept of slope and justify why a written scenario does or does not represent a linear equation.

outcome.title: Writing Equations of Lines
outcome.description: I can use information about the points and slope of a line in order to write its equation.

outcome.title: Systems of Linear Equations
outcome.description: I can write and solve systems of linear equations.

outcome.title: Distance and Midpoint Formulas
outcome.description: I can use ordered pairs to calculate the length and midpoint of a line segment, and use this information to draw conclusions about 2D figures.

outcome.title: Simple and Compound Probability
outcome.description: I can compute probabilities of simple and compound experiments.

outcome.title: Data Displays and Statistical Graphs
outcome.description: I can read and create box plots, histograms, bar graphs, pie charts, stem-and-leaf plots, dot plots, and line plots to display data.

outcome.title: Measures of Central Tendency and Variation
outcome.description: I can compute measures of central tendency and measures of variation of a data set, and interpret their meaning.
